name: Ángel Castro y Argiz
role: Spanish-Cuban Farmer, Father of Fidel Castro
contribution: A Galician-born Cuban farmer and businessman who was the father of Cuban revolutionary leaders Fidel, Raúl and Ramón Castro.

checks.lead: Ángel María Bautista Castro y Argiz (Galician: Anxo María Bautista Castro e Argiz; 5 December 1875 – 21 October 1956) was a Galician-born Cuban farmer and businessman who was the father of Cuban revolutionary leaders Fidel, Raúl and Ramón Castro.
